title: Stones floated in on reed boats and the pyramid site flooded

tellings.quote: built Reed boats uhhuh they actually harvested the stone uhhuh up the Nile

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a man known for remote viewing, a claimed ability to see distant places or times with the mind, offers his own account of how the pyramids at Giza in Egypt were built. He says the builders made reed boats, cut the stone up the Nile, floated it downriver, and that the pyramid site was flooded so the boats could bring the stone in. He links the idea to his book The Ultimate Time Machine, and if true it would explain how such huge blocks were moved.
